interpretation.Evidence: Report PNGs reproduce build/test output; VM PNGs are actual guest captures. Capture-command success does not mean desktop, installer, security or hardware acceptance.
interpretation.First run: qa12-02 failed closed before password input because the splash process did not exit within 20 seconds. No password was generated in that run. Its failures remain in the archive.
interpretation.Diagnostic run: qa12-08 disabled cosmetic splash and added the existing verification flag. Enrollment was concealed; ordinary tty3 login, passwordless-sudo refusal, authenticated diagnostics, real SDDM, incorrect-password refusal and a correct owner graphical session were observed. The inherited session entered the Kubuntu installer prompt, not Plasma. No usable desktop was qualified. The later Plasma-only QPainter setting was not reached.
interpretation.Corrected-image run: qa12-17 normal default UEFI boot concealed enrollment, rendered OREZ SDDM, rejected an incorrect password and accepted the owner. The selected graphical session then exited64 and the greeter restarted. In a separate ordinary authenticated console diagnostic, startplasma-wayland eventually rendered Welcome, the approved wallpaper, panel/system tray and native Quick Settings. Skip closed Welcome. Normal graphical login remains broken; no workload, performance or installed-system pass.
interpretation.Installer: Actual configuration inspection, inactive profile generation and offline dependency simulation are distinct from installation. Only the eight exact requested installer/live packages would be removed; no maintainer scripts or disk installer were executed.
interpretation.Safety: Only disposable offline VM credentials were used and destroyed with their containers after evidence collection. One tty test-driver attempt raced the login timeout and partly echoed the dummy password as a new username; failure frames are retained. No real owner credential, physical SSD, firmware or Windows recovery USB was touched.
interpretation.Scope: No installed footprint, recovery, target NVIDIA/radios/Secure Boot, gaming performance, consumer Android or autonomous OREZ AI qualification is claimed. This archive contains screenshots, not an operating-system download.
